sentences.text: Agentic AI is now delivering measurable results in operations: Northern Trust built an AI onboarding agent that cuts its analysts' data preparation time by 83%.
In client channels, OCBC launched an AI assistant for business account maintenance and Starling Bank went live with voice payments via its AI assistant.
Rex Africa launched in Nigeria as an AI-native bank with a conversational financial agent, while IBK Industrial Bank is piloting Geni-Code, an in-house AI coding agent for staff.
In other live use cases, Kakao Pay Securities runs AI fraud detection on live transactions and VR Bank Rhein Ahr Eifel uses an internal agent that answers staff from internal knowledge.
